resources.string: URMIX is developed by WINATRA to offer an audio-first streaming experience, with the option to switch to video when needed.\n\nWe created URMIX because we wanted a lightweight, sound-focused listening experience with fewer distractions — without giving up access to video when you need it.

URMIX is built on the open-source code and engine of NewPipe. URMIX is an independent fork developed entirely by WINATRA, not an official NewPipe app. NewPipe components are licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later.
Explore the URMIX source code on GitHub or contribute to the project.
Support WINATRA to help us continue developing URMIX.
Visit the URMIX website for more info and news.

The URMIX project takes your privacy very seriously. Therefore, the app does not collect any data without your consent.\nURMIX\'s privacy policy explains in detail what data is sent and stored when you send a crash report.
